mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SCHED_EXTERNAL_API_CALL_LOG ( EXTERNAL_API_ID, FIRE_INSTANCE_ID, STARTED_AT, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{externalApiId}, #{fireInstanceId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{status}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE SCHED_EXTERNAL_API_CALL_LOG SET HTTP_STATUS = #{httpStatus, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, FINISHED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, RUN_MILLIS = #{runMillis, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, STATUS = #{status}, ERROR_MESSAGE = #{errorMessage, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE API_CALL_LOG_ID = #{apiCallLogId}
